title: eludite.debug.exception_settings input
description: The Exception Settings window: Common Language Runtime Exceptions (break when an exception is thrown, first chance, or only when user code does not handle it, Visual Studio's default) and Rust panics (break when a native session's program panics, through a function breakpoint on `rust_panic`). Persisted per solution and applied to a running session at once.

break_on_rust_panic.description: Break when a Rust program (a Cargo package debugged with lldb-dap) panics: a function breakpoint on `rust_panic`. Default true.
